services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Lake Tahoe is North America’s largest and most beautiful alpine lake. It has roughly 72 miles of the most pristine scenic shoreline you can imagine. So come hop aboard. Enjoy all the pleasures of boating, with none of the hassle. Our 3rd party captains* are eager to show you the sites on Lake Tahoe’s most luxurious charter boats. Choose any boat from our top-of-line rental fleet and add a captain at an hourly rate. You’ll be taken to historic sites such as the Thunderbird Lodge and the “Tea House” in Emerald Bay, or take a peek at the lakefront mansions of the rich & famous.
